operations.title: Benincasa reports exact homogeneous five-site character grading
operations.body: Entry 1291 strengthens 1286: restoring a single external scale rho makes every Kummer coefficient C_S exactly homogeneous with deg(C_S)+|S|=16. All 32 characters and 43296 terms survive. This is presently a numerator grading; the next test is whether the 26-wall localized differential respects the corresponding graded shifts.
